title: Order Share Decision Table for OTC Mail Catalog Orders
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit, over-the-counter allowance.** The order share is the part of the member's remaining allowance that one mail catalog order may take. It multiplies the figure left once the register keep-back has been subtracted from the allowance balance, and it is applied before the shipping fee is subtracted.

**Rule.** The order share is six tenths (0.6) where two or more mail catalog or online orders are still open and the purchases tagged to the latest forfeited quarter reached at least three quarters (0.75) of the amount loaded for it; eight tenths (0.8) where two or more such orders are still open and those purchases reached less than three quarters of it; and the whole where fewer than two such orders are still open.

**Terms used.**
- The orders still open are the plan's mail catalog and online orders allowed per quarter less those already tagged to the current quarter, the calendar quarter that contains today.
- The latest forfeited quarter is the benefit quarter of the most recently posted forfeiture entry in the coverage's allowance activity. Where nothing was loaded for it, its purchases are taken as reaching less than three quarters.

### Decision table

| Orders still open | Purchases of the latest forfeited quarter against its load | Order share |
|---|---|---|
| Two or more | 0.75 or more | 0.6 |
| Two or more | Below 0.75 | 0.8 |
| Fewer than two | any | The whole (1) |

### Cases (hypothetical)

| Plan orders per quarter | Orders already this quarter | Still open | Latest forfeited quarter: loaded / purchases | Order share |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | 0 | 2 | $50.00 / $40.00 (0.8) | 0.6 |
| 2 | 0 | 2 | $50.00 / $30.00 (0.6) | 0.8 |
| 2 | 1 | 1 | any | 1 |
